wire.label: WIRE-FORM BYTE PIN (the core golden pin): the selected request's FULL body, canonically serialized (sort_keys + compact separators) with the three normalize paths nulled, must equal the fixture byte-for-byte. Normalization is key-sorted canonicalization only — list order is significant (input[] is the conversation, in order); volatile per-run values are nulled via the normalize list, never by reordering. Mismatch = structured field-level diff (TDD RED artifact), not a bare FAIL.

SCOPE BOUND (the B-i companion count pin): the where-filter (method + path + body.model + headers.x-grok-session-id) matches exactly ONE capture in this case's wire dir — the golden assert's selection is unambiguous because N is bounded here. A foreign session's same-shape request (parallel hermetic run) is excluded by the x-grok-session-id key; a missing capture (harness failure) or an extra match (scope too wide) both FAIL this pin.
